title: Ethernet Send
text: Send Ethernet packets from target computer, 2 inputs, {Interface Name} sets Target computer interface name wm0; {Overwrite source MAC address} sets the replace source MAC Address with MAC address from Data, {Enable Simulink messages} sets the data as messages and {Sample Time} sets the sample time of block. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Data
ports.summary: Inport for Ethernet packet signal input for constructed Ethernet packet

ports.name: Length
ports.summary: Number of bytes of data to transmit double

params.name: Interface Name
params.values: Target computer interface name wm0 | wm1 | character vector

params.name: Overwrite source MAC address
params.values: Replace source MAC Address with MAC address from Data port off (default) | on
